# Go test/benchmark/fuzz functions deliberately removed from the tree, one per
# line, as:
#
#   <FuncName> [baseline:<digest>]  # <file> :: <grep target> :: <bucket>
#
# <FuncName> is the name the function had when it was deleted. Every entry has to
# resolve to a function the baseline commit actually contained, and there are two
# ways for it to do so:
#
#   * the name appears in go-test-func-baseline.txt, which is the case whenever
#     the function was already behaviourally named at baseline; or
#   * the function was renamed out of the ID-shaped half before it was deleted, so
#     its current name is in neither baseline fixture. Those entries carry
#     baseline:<digest>, the truncated digest of the name it had at baseline, which
#     must be listed in go-test-func-baseline-id-shaped-digests.txt.
#
# An entry that resolves neither way fails the gate instead of quietly lowering
# the expected total, and so does an entry whose function is still in the tree.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
